rule_name: Certifying staff must hold valid licence AND type endorsement for the aircraft family
Type rating must be valid (not expired) on the date of flight
Valid airport access ID required for airside work
De-icing operators need valid annual de-icing certificate
Minimum cabin crew = 1 per 50 seats (see aircraft_types.min_cabin_crew); every flight needs a qualified Purser
